observations: Photo 0 shows an open wardrobe/closet frame with multiple shelves and hanging space (no doors).
Shelves appear to be made of wood/wood-like panels with a grid of compartments.
Some items are stored inside the wardrobe in the photo, limiting visibility of the frame condition.
No clear brand/model markings visible in the photo.

identity.kind: open wardrobe (shelved closet with hanging rail, no doors)

claims.claim: It a open wardrobe, can be used at home or boutique
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows an open wardrobe, but the 'home or boutique' suitability is not verifiable from the image alone.

risks.risk: Condition issues not visible due to stored items (shelf sagging, broken panels, loose joints).
risks.proof: Request a clear photo of the empty wardrobe from the front and both sides, plus close-ups of shelf corners and joints.
risks.if_unproven: Price as average used condition with possible minor wear; do not assume it is sturdy or damage-free.

risks.risk: Missing/unstable hanging rail or hardware (if present) and overall stability.
risks.proof: Request a short video showing the hanging rail area and a gentle shake test from the top frame (seller holds it steady).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed fully stable; treat as standard used furniture.

risks.risk: Size/dimensions unknown, which strongly affects value.
risks.proof: Request exact measurements (height, width, depth) and whether shelves are adjustable.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lower end of comparable open wardrobes.

proof_requests: Empty-wardrobe photos: front, left side, right side, and back (if any).
Close-ups of shelf supports/joints and any damaged/warped areas.
Exact measurements (H x W x D) and number of shelves/compartments.
Video showing stability (gentle shake) and the hanging rail/hardware.
response.reason: The photo clearly shows an open, shelved wardrobe frame, so it can be priced using the closest comparables. However, condition and dimensions are not fully verifiable, so it should be priced at the worst case within the comparable range.
